raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

- FlashInfer's MoE autotune runs a decode dummy forward on zero-filled buffers
  ([`base_runner.py`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/1dd0f361b83a0f4c5fe917c37fc60525972c26e2/python/sglang/srt/model_executor/runner/base_runner.py#L392-L416)).
- Every row is token 0, so every row is routed to the same experts.
- FlashInfer tunes its MoE tactics on these repeated routes, a pattern real decode never produces.
- On Kimi-K3 (896 experts, top-16, EP8) the resulting picks are 13-16 % slower per MoE layer at 24-32 tokens,
  and the pick changes from launch to launch.

## Modifications

- `flashinfer_autotune.py`: `autotune_dummy_input_ids()` fills the static `input_ids` with seeded, distinct token ids
  for the tuning forward and zeroes them afterwards.
- `base_runner.py`: the decode tuning forward runs inside it.
- Unchanged: the other dummy buffers, the extend tuning pass, and the cache key and format (an existing cache is reused
  until it is retuned).

## Tested configurations

| | Kimi-K3 | gpt-oss-120b |
|---|---|---|
| Hardware | 8x B300 | 8x B300 |
| Server | `--tp-size 8 --dcp-size 8 --ep-size 8` | `--tp 8` |
| MoE runner | `flashinfer_mxfp4` | `flashinfer_mxfp4` |
| Builds | main @ [3c56008](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/3c560089e1818a5217a73f2168273485a5350341), with and without this change | same |
| Speed | `bench_one_batch_server`, input 8192, output 512 | input 2048, output 512 |
| Launches | 2 per build, fresh autotune each | same |
| Accuracy | sgl-eval gsm8k, 1,319 questions | - |

The PR is rebased onto current main; the unit tests pass there.

## Results

**Kimi-K3, aggregated** (decode output tok/s, mean of 2 launches)

| | batch 8 | batch 16 | batch 24 | batch 32 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| main @ 3c56008 | 554.7 | 795.4 | 1077.1 | 1305.3 |
| this PR | 555.2 (+0.1 %) | 856.7 (+7.7 %) | 1132.1 (+5.1 %) | 1372.4 (+5.1 %) |
| together with #45544 | 592.4 (+6.8 %) | 898.9 (+13.0 %) | 1168.0 (+8.4 %) | 1397.4 (+7.1 %) |

- Launch ranges are apart from main at batch 16, 24 and 32.
- Prefill throughput and TTFT within 1 %; startup tuning time unchanged.
- #45544 is independent (no shared files); the last row has both applied.

**gpt-oss-120b, aggregated** (decode output tok/s, mean of 2 launches)

| | batch 8 | batch 16 | batch 32 | batch 64 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| main @ 3c56008 | 3045.1 | 5661.0 | 10260.2 | 17571.3 |
| this PR | 3017.8 (-0.9 %) | 5636.7 (-0.4 %) | 10253.7 (-0.1 %) | 17612.9 (+0.2 %) |

- Neutral within the launch ranges: on this model (128 experts, top-4) main already picks the fast tiles.

**Accuracy, Kimi-K3** (sgl-eval gsm8k, model preset, max_tokens 32768)

| | score |
|---|---|
| main @ 3c56008 | 97.12 % |
| this PR | 97.73 % |

- Within the noise of one temperature-1.0 pass; the change only picks GEMM tactics.

## Tests

Four CPU tests in `test/registered/unit/model_executor/runner/test_flashinfer_autotune_sync.py`:
- the tuned forward sees distinct in-vocab ids and the buffer is zero afterwards (fails without the change: `1 != 56`);
- every rank tunes on the same ids;
- the buffer is zeroed when the forward fails;
- more rows than the vocabulary stay in range.

pre-commit passes on the changed files.

<details>
<summary>Reproduce</summary>

```bash
git clone https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang && cd sglang
git checkout 3c560089e1818a5217a73f2168273485a5350341      # main; apply this PR's diff for the other build
pip install -e python
pytest test/registered/unit/model_executor/runner/test_flashinfer_autotune_sync.py

export SGLANG_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_CACHE=0 SGLANG_CACHE_DIR=$(mktemp -d)   # fresh autotune per launch

python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --trust-remote-code \
  --tp-size 8 --dcp-size 8 --ep-size 8 --mem-fraction-static 0.85 \
  --linear-attn-prefill-backend triton --linear-attn-decode-backend triton \
  --reasoning-parser kimi_k3 --port 30000
python -m sglang.bench_one_batch_server --model-path moonshotai/Kimi-K3 \
  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:30000 --batch-size 8 16 24 32 --input-len 8192 --output-len 512

python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path openai/gpt-oss-120b --tp 8 \
  --reasoning-parser gpt-oss --port 30000
python -m sglang.bench_one_batch_server --model-path openai/gpt-oss-120b \
  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:30000 --batch-size 8 16 32 64 --input-len 2048 --output-len 512

uv venv .sgl-eval && uv pip install --python .sgl-eval/bin/python sgl-eval==0.1.3
.sgl-eval/bin/sgl-eval run gsm8k --base-url http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1 \
  --load-preset-from-model-id moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --max-tokens 32768 --num-examples 1319
```
</details>

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

 from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_context import ForwardContext, forward_context
 from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.flashinfer_autotune import (
+    autotune_dummy_input_ids,
     maybe_flashinfer_autotune_extend,
     run_flashinfer_autotune_forward,
     should_run_flashinfer_autotune,
@@ -411,9 +412,12 @@ def forward_fn():
                 run_ctx=canary_run_ctx,
             )
 
-        run_flashinfer_autotune_forward(
-            self.model_runner, forward_fn, run_lm_head=False
-        )
+        with autotune_dummy_input_ids(
+            buffers.input_ids, vocab_size=mr.model_config.vocab_size
+        ):
+            run_flashinfer_autotune_forward(
+                self.model_runner, forward_fn, run_lm_head=False
+            )
 
     def _alloc_dummy_decode_buffers(
         self,

@@ -49,6 +49,30 @@
 
 FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_WORKAROUND_SKIPS = frozenset()
 
+# Arbitrary; the ids only need to be distinct and the same on every rank.
+AUTOTUNE_DUMMY_TOKEN_SEED = 0
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def autotune_dummy_input_ids(input_ids: torch.Tensor, *, vocab_size: int):
+    """Distinct token ids for the autotune dummy forward, zeroed again after.
+
+    The static buffers are zero-filled, so every dummy row embeds token 0 and the
+    MoE router sends every row to the same experts; FlashInfer tunes its MoE
+    tactics on the caller's routes, so they would be ranked on a traffic pattern
+    no real batch produces. Zero is what the buffer owners expect afterwards.
+    """
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(AUTOTUNE_DUMMY_TOKEN_SEED)
+    ids = torch.randperm(vocab_size, generator=gen)
+    num_tokens = input_ids.shape[0]
+    if num_tokens > vocab_size:
+        ids = ids.repeat(-(-num_tokens // vocab_size))
+    input_ids.copy_(ids[:num_tokens])
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        input_ids.zero_()
+
 
 def get_flashinfer_autotune_skip_ops(model_runner: ModelRunner) -> set[str]:
     skip_ops = set(get_exec().kernel.flashinfer_autotune_skip_ops or ())

@@ -26,11 +26,14 @@
 import torch
 import torch.distributed as dist
 
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner import base_runner
 from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner import flashinfer_autotune as autotune
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.base_runner import BaseRunner
 from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.flashinfer_autotune import (
     _autotune_cache_digest,
     _autotune_tactic_sync_group,
     _drop_diverged_autotune_cache,
+    autotune_dummy_input_ids,
 )
 from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
 from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, find_available_port
@@ -308,6 +311,65 @@ def test_caches_diverging_only_in_metadata_are_dropped(self):
         )
 
 
+VOCAB = 163840
+
+
+def _ids_seen_by_the_tuned_forward(buffers, *, batch_size: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    seen = []
+    runner = SimpleNamespace(
+        model_runner=SimpleNamespace(
+            canary_manager=None, model_config=SimpleNamespace(vocab_size=VOCAB)
+        ),
+        _dummy_run=lambda **kw: seen.append(kw["buffers"].input_ids.clone()),
+    )
+    with patch.object(
+        base_runner, "run_flashinfer_autotune_forward", lambda mr, fn, **kw: fn()
+    ):
+        BaseRunner._flashinfer_autotune(runner, buffers=buffers, batch_size=batch_size)
+    return seen[0]
+
+
+class TestAutotuneDummyInputIds(CustomTestCase):
+    """The dummy forward must not tune on identical rows.
+
+    The static dummy buffers are zero-filled, so every row embedded token 0 and
+    the MoE router sent all rows to the same experts; FlashInfer ranked its MoE
+    tactics on that pattern, and the picks were slower on real decode batches.
+    """
+
+    def test_tuned_forward_sees_distinct_in_vocab_rows(self):
+        buffers = SimpleNamespace(input_ids=torch.zeros(56, dtype=torch.int64))
+        ids = _ids_seen_by_the_tuned_forward(buffers, batch_size=56)
+        self.assertEqual(ids.unique().numel(), 56)
+        self.assertTrue(bool((ids >= 0).all()) and bool((ids < VOCAB).all()))
+        # The decode graph runner captures from these buffers afterwards.
+        self.assertTrue(bool((buffers.input_ids == 0).all()))
+
+    def test_every_rank_tunes_on_the_same_rows(self):
+        # Ranks reduce their timings per tactic, so they must profile the same routes.
+        runs = [
+            _ids_seen_by_the_tuned_forward(
+                SimpleNamespace(input_ids=torch.zeros(56, dtype=torch.int64)),
+                batch_size=56,
+            )
+            for _ in range(2)
+        ]
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(runs[0], runs[1]))
+
+    def test_buffer_is_zeroed_when_the_forward_fails(self):
+        ids = torch.zeros(8, dtype=torch.int64)
+        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
+            with autotune_dummy_input_ids(ids, vocab_size=VOCAB):
+                raise RuntimeError("tuning failed")
+        self.assertTrue(bool((ids == 0).all()))
+
+    def test_more_rows_than_vocab_stay_in_vocab(self):
+        ids = torch.zeros(20, dtype=torch.int64)
+        with autotune_dummy_input_ids(ids, vocab_size=8):
+            self.assertTrue(bool((ids < 8).all()))
+            self.assertEqual(ids.unique().numel(), 8)
+
+
 class TestModelPrefillAutotune(CustomTestCase):
     """Model kernel warmup must cover prefill without a speculative dummy batch."""
